newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean trade minister to be replaced --Yonhap.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean trade minister to be replaced --Yonhap.

text.p: South Korea's trade minister Park Jae-yoon will be replaced by the current deputy finance minister Lee Hwan-kyun in a partial cabinet reshuffle on Friday, Yonhap news agency reported.
The presidential Blue House said there had been no formal announcement of any reshuffle.
Yonhap also said that current minister of Science and Technology Koo Bohn-young will be named as South Korea's first ambassador to the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development.
South Korea formally joined the Paris-based organisation this month.
Yonhap gave no reason for the replacement of the current minister of Trade, Industry and Energy and did not say whether he had been offered any new position.
In other changes, Yonhap reported that the First Minister of Political Affairs, Kim Deog-ryong, would be replaced by Park Bum-jin, a parliamentary member of the ruling New Korea Party.
Environment Minister Chung Chong-teck is to be replaced by Kim Han-kyu, a former parliamentary member of the ruling party, it added.
Also to be replaced are the minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, the minister of Legislation and the head of the National Police Agency, Yonhap said.
